facts.scope: Logo redesign; WordPress build; mega menu with clickable parents; Gravity Forms (general enquiry, request a quote, lodge a claim, workplace injury, insurance program review); secure PDF storage for claim and injury forms; Pay an Invoice page linking to DEFT (Macquarie); FAQ accordions; blog and insights with filtering; team profiles; EDM integration; LinkedIn feed; testimonials; schema; compliance content and AFSL footer; content migration (placement only, 14 hours); SEO migration (9 hours); training; 30-day support See 06.in_scope. Plus hover effects and micro-interactions, video and image support, spam protection
facts.excluded: Accessibility audit and WCAG remediation; content writing, restructuring or rewriting; a true payment gateway (Stripe, Ebix) or WinBEAT NEXT API; client portal; photography and video; SEO retainer; Google Ads; annual third-party subscriptions
facts.audience: B2B, SME to enterprise, strong mid-market bias. Personal lines exist for existing clients but are not the focus

If Macquarie's payment portal is changing, we need to know which payment option you land on, as it changes what we build on the Pay an Invoice page.
